Rather than moving, Hudson Construction and Remodeling LLC can build up — adding an entirely new level to your existing home. Lincolnwood homeowners, if your fence has started to lean after this year's wet stretch, the posts are the first place to look. Push on a few sections and see if they wobble at the ground line, since that is usually where rot starts. Check for soft, dark wood right where the post meets the soil, and look along the fence line for sections that sit lower than the rest. Catching a rotted post early often means a simple repair, while waiting can turn it into a full section replacement. We can take a look and tell you which one you are dealing with.
